<b>An Icon of Hope</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall of [[Bone Bottom]] after entering [[The Citadel]] and completing [[A Lifesaving Bridge]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{S|440}} to the Bone Bottom Wishwall.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Wishwall.png!Location of Wishwall in Bone Bottom
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Hornet Statuette.png|link=Hornet Statuette|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the quest, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can speak to [[Flick the Fixer]] to receive the [[Hornet Statuette]]. A destructible statue of Flick is also erected beside the lift that leads to [[Mosshome]]. If the statue is destroyed, it is never rebuilt. The statue becomes permanently destroyed regardless in [[Act 3]]. 

Flick's statue behaves like a cache of [[Shell Shards]]. It can be hit up to 6 times, dropping a small number of Shell Shards each time, and a larger quantity upon breaking. Unlike the bridge from <i>[[A Lifesaving Bridge]]</i>, any damage inflicted on the statue is permanent, so it does not recover from partial damage when Hornet moves to a different screen, or when the game is reloaded.
